params.name: Name format
params.tooltip:
How a vehicle's name is put together. Line formats use the
model instead for a vehicle without a line. Names are cut to
50 characters by shortening the model, then the line, never
the number.
values: Model + line + number: Citaro · Bus 12 · B-0412

params.name: Model name
params.tooltip:
Which part of the model name goes into the name. Short drops
the first word (often the maker) when there are two or more.

params.name: Type prefix
params.tooltip:
What stands before the fleet number. Letters: B bus, T
truck, R tram, L train, S ship, A aircraft, H helicopter.

params.name: Between prefix and number
params.tooltip: The character between the type prefix and the fleet number.

params.name: Between name parts
params.tooltip:
What separates the model, the line and the number.
Automatic: a space after the model, a middle dot around a
line name.

params.name: Number digits
params.tooltip:
Numbers get leading zeros up to this many digits. Larger
numbers show all their digits.

params.name: First number
params.tooltip:
Where the counters start. Raising it later moves the
counters up; numbers already given stay as they are.

params.name: Counting
params.tooltip:
Per type: each type has its own counter. One for all: one
counter for every vehicle. Per model: each model counts on
its own, and a replaced vehicle takes the next number of its
new model. Per line: after the line name, the vehicles of a
line count 1, 2, 3 in the order they joined it; when one
leaves, the ones behind it move up. Every vehicle keeps its
fleet numbers, so switching never mixes them up.

params.name: Purchase year
params.tooltip:
Adds the year the vehicle was bought. Before the number, the
year takes the place of the type prefix.

params.name: Mark vehicles past their lifespan
params.tooltip:
Adds a mark at the end of the name of a vehicle that is
older than its model's lifespan. The mark goes away when the
vehicle is replaced. The hourglass may show as a question
mark in some game fonts: then pick the star or the word.

params.name: Train length
params.tooltip:
For trains: the number of wagons after the model name (parts
without power; locomotives, power cars and powered cars of
multiple units are not counted), or the number of all units
of the train.

params.name: Line name in names
params.tooltip:
For the formats with a line: the whole line name, its first
12 characters, or the first number in it (the whole name
when it has none).

params.name: Hand-typed names
params.tooltip:
Keep them: a name you typed yourself is never changed, and
the vehicle keeps its fleet number in the background. Clear
the name and it gets its fleet name again. Rename them too:
typed names are replaced as well.

params.name: Number existing vehicles on next load
params.tooltip:
For a save where you chose Not now: Yes shows the welcome
window again on the next load, so you can number the
existing vehicles, oldest first. Save your game first.
On a save where you chose Apply it does nothing: every
vehicle is numbered already.

params.name: Renaming speed
params.tooltip:
How many vehicles are renamed at most every 2 seconds of
game time. A large fleet is numbered over a few minutes.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Better Auto Vehicle
Renamer writes how long its renaming took to the game's log
file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]). Only for
tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls
are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
